note: I028: what passengers say, now and then, about what actually happens aboard. Picked by GuestReactions from the event and the traveller's traits; %s is the traveller's first name where a line needs it. Each line is a 'text' (gettext). Kept short and warm: a passenger is a person, not a meter.

boarding.text: Permission to come aboard? Thank you for having us.
So this is home for the next few days. Lovely.
Where would you like my bag?

rough_anxious.text: Is it meant to lean this much? I'll just hold on here.
I'm trying to be brave about the waves.

rough_hardy.text: Now this is sailing! Look at that spray.
Don't slow down on my account.

calm_relaxed.text: I could watch the water all day.
This is exactly what I hoped for.

cautious_thanks.text: Thank you for waiting out the weather. I feel safer for it.
A sensible choice, Captain. I'd rather arrive late than frightened.

scenic_photo.text: Hold on, the light is perfect. Just one more photo.

scenic_plain.text: What a place. I'm glad we came this way.

privacy_unhappy.text: I didn't quite expect to share the saloon with everyone at night.

comfort_unhappy.text: It's a little more rustic than I imagined, but never mind.

delay_strict.text: Are we still on time? I have a connection to make.
I'm a bit worried about my onward journey.

delay_relaxed.text: Late? Who cares. More time at sea.

pet_lover.text: Your companion just fell asleep on my feet. Best voyage ever.
May I give them a little treat?

chat.text: How long have you been living aboard?
Do you ever get tired of the sea? I can't imagine it.
Tell me about the best harbour you've known.
Is the coffee always this good, or is it the sea air?

farewell_happy.text: Thank you for everything. I'll tell all my friends.
I'll remember this for a long time. Fair winds, Captain.

farewell_unhappy.text: Well, we got here. Thank you, I suppose.

dream_fulfilled.text: I've wanted this for years. Thank you for making it real.
